purpose: Authored room assembly flipbook fallback for browsers with WebGL unavailable. Illustrative scenes, not catalog product imagery.

rendering.method: Isolated authored Three.js WebGL scene captured synchronously with captureAssemblyFrames(16), then native ImageMagick montage alpha WebP encoding.

semantic.implementation: RoomScene renders the matching sprite through a CSS background on a 640/470 aspect-ratio element. WAAPI selects row-major positions of all 16 frames over 1750ms for room changes and replay. Preserve the assembled static image after completion and for reduced motion. Keep room and finish controls, text, page background and component framing semantic HTML/CSS.
semantic.notes: Frame 0 is exploded; frame 15 is assembled. CSS owns display sizing, clipping and animation timing. Browser WebGL retains authored live rendering when available.

assumptions: Use existing assembled images after animation and for reduced motion.
All sprites preserve true alpha and contain no UI.

validation.visualInspection: All nine final frames inspected as contact sheet. Representative walnut room frames 0,7,15 inspected for living, bedroom and office: furniture moves into place, final frame preserves authored static perspective and geometry. Final-frame side-by-side contact sheet against original assembled WebPs confirms matching camera, composition, palette and lighting. No UI, text, borders, rounded framing or page background is baked into assets.
validation.deterministicCapture: All nine final WebP SHA256 hashes match across two independent isolated Playwright Chromium capture runs.
validation.trueAlpha: All nine files are sRGBA with alpha minimum 0 and maximum 1.
validation.terminalFrameDuplicates: 16 frames are retained as specified. Authored easing completes some rooms before the final timestamp: living and office have 15 unique PNG frames, bedroom has 14. Terminal duplicates are expected and preserve the source timing.
